blindSourceSummaries: July 2026 anti-trans legal-risk assessment map (republication of an activist publication's state-by-state map): scores every state of the country for transgender adults and lists this state/province among the fifteen protective-grouping states, naming it specifically with three sibling states as having comprehensive health-insurance laws covering facial-hair removal and an expanded range of medical procedures, with refuge protections for people fleeing restrictive states. This state/province is among the shield-law states cited in its protective grouping.
